about: One act, two engine shapes. The launcher tests (clients/octryx-claude/tests/test_engine_conformance.py) assert both shapes reach the platform as the same normalised request; the backend tests (backend/tests/conformance/test_engine_conformance.py) assert the platform decides them the same. Paths are relative to the run's working copy, written into cwd at test time. expect.reason is the platform's reason; expect.pause the run's pause reason after the call (null: not paused).

accepted_differences.ask_is_deny_on_codex: Codex hooks know only allow and deny; the launcher turns a platform 'ask' into a deny (codex_hook_input.without_ask).
accepted_differences.updated_input_dropped_on_codex: The platform's corrected input (updated_input) runs in Claude Code; Codex runs the call as written (hook_outputs._rewritten).
accepted_differences.patch_split_per_file: Codex apply_patch (tool or shell) becomes one Write/Edit per file with only file_path and codex_patch; Claude Code's Edit carries old/new strings. The platform decides on tool and path.
accepted_differences.view_image_is_read: Codex view_image is decided as a Read of the image path.
accepted_differences.mcp_server_name: Codex names the platform MCP server octryx_knowledge (no '-'); the launcher maps it to octryx-knowledge.
accepted_differences.stop_deferred_on_codex: Codex's Stop hook only saves its input; the driver replays it after the turn and reads the verdict itself (same /sessions/verification body, later).
accepted_differences.approvals_via_app_server: Codex's own approval requests (command, file change) go through the app-server to the person's chat decide, not to tool-check.
accepted_differences.usage_source: Claude Code usage comes from its transcript; Codex usage from app-server tokenUsage events.
accepted_differences.exec_evidence: A Codex code-mode exec is recorded from its inner calls (codex_exec_evidence).
accepted_differences.fail_open_hook_guard: Codex runs a call whose hook fails, so its guard lets a call run only on an explicit allow.
accepted_differences.unknown_model_state: Codex names an unknown model codex_error_modelNotFound; Claude Code has no named state for it (accepted, no new state).
